title: MetaLogDiff v0
description: Pair-wise difference between two MetaLog documents (SPEC §13).

additionalProperties.description: Open, and NOT by design: this root admits any member, including a bare vendor member §7 forbids beside the `extensions` container it grants, so an unknown key here validates and is reported legal-but-undescribed rather than rejected. Closing it is a breaking change under GOVERNANCE.md §2 and is not in this release.

diff_version.description: The SPEC version this MetaLogDiff conforms to (SPEC §13.1.1) — the SAME axis as metalog.v0.schema.json's metalog_version, for the other document this specification defines, and NOT a second version axis of its own. The pattern constrains the SHAPE and cannot constrain the VALUE: a document declaring 0.6.0 while carrying comparison_outcome (required from v0.10.0) validates here and is nonetheless self-contradictory, which §13.1.1 forbids in prose because no keyword can reach it. Meaning declared in v0.10.0; before that the schema pinned a shape and the prose declared nothing.

additionalProperties.description: Open, and NOT by design: this window object names `start` and `end` and admits anything else, while the document-level `window` (§2.2) is closed. Closing it is a breaking change under GOVERNANCE.md §2 and is not in this release.

Open, and NOT by design: this window object names `start` and `end` and admits anything else, while the document-level `window` (§2.2) is closed. Closing it is a breaking change under GOVERNANCE.md §2 and is not in this release.

comparison_outcome.description: The producer's assertion about the comparison it performed (SPEC 13.2): `changed` means the comparison found at least one change and the document MUST carry a witness; `unchanged` means it ran and found none, and the document MUST NOT carry one. Not a summary of which fields were serialised.

x-metalog-vacuous.description: stability_score is 1 - js_divergence, so its no-change value is ONE, not zero.
The array is a union over both windows' templates, so it is non-empty whenever either window is. The finding is a non-zero delta, never a row.
Vacuous when no slot's distribution moved: no rows.

field_histogram_deltas.description: Per-slot value-distribution change between the two documents' param_histograms (SPEC §3.5.2). MUST be sorted by js_divergence descending — an ordering the schema cannot assert; §3.5.2 owns it. Added to the schema in v0.8.0 (normative in the prose since v0.3.0).

previous_sample_count.description: Observations backing the previous distribution (that slot's param_histogram total). The sample size js_divergence is estimated from — a consumer's min-sample confidence floor. Distinct from cardinality (distinct values) and from the template's stream share. Added in v0.8.0.

current_sample_count.description: Observations backing the current distribution. See previous_sample_count. Added in v0.8.0.

x-metalog-vacuous.description: Vacuous when no template's branching entropy moved.
ngram_size is a PARAMETER, never a finding; the finding is a non-empty list. An absent list is an empty one.
Nine members, no array: the finding is a non-zero delta. The six previous_/current_ members are the coordinates the deltas are taken between and are never findings on their own.

tail_delta.description: Long-tail shape change (SPEC §13). Present only when both documents carried a stats.tail_summary.

x-metalog-vacuous.description: axes is the diff's declared coordinate space -- a DESCRIPTOR (SPEC 13.6), required and non-empty, and never a finding. The finding is a populated emerging/vanishing border.

cube_diff.description: Emerging-border diff of two cube blocks (SPEC §13.6, §16). Present only when both inputs carried a cube and their axes are equal. Experimental, added in v0.6.0.

emerging.description: Growth region (count_prev <= theta_was AND count_cur >= theta_now): order-convex, a (lower, upper) border pair.

vanishing.description: Disappearance region (the dual): count_prev >= theta_was AND count_cur <= theta_now.

x-metalog-vacuous.description: Vacuous when no salient template appeared, vanished or crossed the failure frontier. An absent list is an empty one.

reservoir_delta.description: Rare-salient membership change between the two documents' stats.reservoir blocks (SPEC §13.7). Membership is decided over top_k UNION reservoir on each side, never over reservoir alone: a template that moved between the two retention mechanisms has not appeared or disappeared. Omitted entirely when all three lists are empty; every list MUST be sorted by template_id ascending — an ordering the schema cannot assert. Added in v0.9.0.

new_salient.description: Entries in current.stats.reservoir whose template_id is in neither of previous's two blocks. count and salience are current's (SPEC §13.7.1).

vanished_salient.description: Entries in previous.stats.reservoir whose template_id is in neither of current's two blocks. count and salience are previous's (SPEC §13.7.1).

frontier_crossings.description: Templates present on BOTH sides whose level crossed the {ERROR, FATAL} failure frontier (SPEC §13.7.2). Frontier membership is a SET test, never an ordinal compare against ERROR.

direction.description: Oriented previous -> current: up = crossed INTO the frontier, down = crossed OUT. Signed and polarity-mute — whether that is an escalation or a recovery is the consumer's reading, not this document's claim.

x-metalog-vacuous.description: Vacuous when the producer withheld no finding: no names. Any name is a finding -- the finding being that ANOTHER signal property carries one this document does not show.

withheld_signals.description: The signal properties in which THIS comparison found a change that this document does not carry (SPEC §13.2.2). It is the witness of last resort: a producer that finds a change only in a property it does not serialise has, without this member, no conformant outcome -- `changed` would carry no witness and `unchanged` would be false. Every member MUST name a property of the witness set (§13.2.1 step 2), MUST NOT name `withheld_signals` itself, and MUST name a property that is NOT a witness in this document; the array MUST be sorted ascending and carries no duplicates. The membership and ordering MUSTs are §13.2.2's: an enum here would be the hand-kept list §13.2 deleted, and sortedness is not a keyword. Added in v0.10.0.

extensions.description: Document-level vendor-specific data on a MetaLogDiff (SPEC §7). This placement was granted in v0.9.0. The root itself is open — its `additionalProperties` declares the openness and constrains nothing — so a bare vendor member written beside this container validates while violating §7: the container is where such data belongs, and at an open root the schema does not tell the two apart.

reservoir_delta_entry.description: One rare-salient membership change (SPEC §13.7.1). A SUBSET of the §3.7.1 reservoir entry, and every field means there what it means here. count and salience MUST be copied from the document the entry comes from, never re-derived at diff time; salience is comparable across the pair only because §2.4's gate already requires a matching retention_profile.

extensions.description: The §7 extension container: reverse-DNS keys, arbitrary payloads, closed to everything else. Mirrors metalog.v0.schema.json #/$defs/extensions — DUPLICATED rather than cross-referenced, because each schema file is independently consumable and a cross-file $ref cannot be resolved offline. conformance/metalog_validate.py --selftest asserts that every $defs name the two files share is identical, so the duplicate cannot drift. Closure is preserved: a misspelled STANDARD member is still rejected by its object, because it is not inside this container.

cube_axis.description: A cube axis descriptor (SPEC §16.2). Mirrors metalog.v0.schema.json #/$defs/cube_axis.

band_floor.description: Ordinal-axis collapse stamp (SPEC §16.2/§16.10): the applied interval-banding floor, omitted when no banding was applied. It is carried here because §13.6 requires cube_diff.axes to EQUAL both inputs' cube.axes, so a diff of two collapsed cubes carries the stamp its inputs carry. Added to metalog.v0.schema.json in v0.8.0 and to this mirror in v0.9.0.

cube_coord.description: A cube cell coordinate, generic over axes (SPEC §16.4). Each key is a cube axis NAME; an absent axis means aggregated (*). Categorical value = string; chain value = ordered prefix-path array. Mirrors metalog.v0.schema.json #/$defs/cube_coord.

cube_border.description: An order-convex emerging/vanishing region as a (lower, upper) border pair (SPEC §13.6). lower = most-specific cells (the precise description); upper = most-general cells (the minimal generators = the deterministic headline).
